name: Aihara Takuya
source:
As a girl, everything changes for Takuya. (S)he's suddenly the center of attention; it seems every man around wants a date! As a guy, Takuya may had been just a simple wimp. However, as a girl he, or she, has a perfect body and everyone seems to be noticing it. How will Takuya react to the newfound popularity? Of course, he's curious about sex, but how far can he take it? Will he find a way to change back into a man? Will he want to at the very end?

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582010-x-change/faqs/22272]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
